data.name: Chirayu
data.gender_notes: Chirayu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chirayu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chira' meaning young and 'Ayu' meaning life or god. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Vishnu, who is often referred to as 'Chirayu' in certain scriptures. This name signifies the young and brave form of the god. The name Chirayu carries the meaning “Young, Brave God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chirayu usually hope their child will grow to embody young, brave god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chirayu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young, Brave God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chirayu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
